crossRefs.note: For the ear tries words, as the palate tastes food.
I speak as to wise men. Judge what I say.
so that you may approve the things that are excellent, that you may be sincere and without offense to the day of Christ,
But solid food is for those who are full grown, who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern good and…
if indeed you have tasted that the Lord is gracious:
Is there injustice on my tongue? Can’t my taste discern mischievous things?

translations.web: Doesn’t the ear try words, even as the palate tastes its food?
translations.bsb: Does not the ear test words as the tongue tastes its food?
translations.kjv: Doth not the ear try words? and the mouth taste his meat?
translations.asv: Doth not the ear try words, Even as the palate tasteth its food?
